## What's free

Hobby (non-commercial only): 100 GB transfer, 1M edge requests, 1M function invocations; only the 3 latest production deployments kept

> Free tiers change without notice. Check <https://vercel.com/pricing> before relying on this.

## Plan

- `modules/<service>`: the managed resources, sized to the free tier by default
- `stack/`: the root module whose outputs expose connection details (sensitive values marked `sensitive`)
